--- ## Platform Overview PolyBuzz AI is an innovative AI character chat platform dedicated to providing users with rich and diverse virtual character interaction experiences. The platform features over 20 million unique AI characters, covering various types such as anime characters, historical figures, and original creations, creating an unprecedented AI conversation ecosystem for users. **Core Mission**: Redefine human-machine interaction through a vast library of high-quality AI characters, so every user can find the perfect AI conversation partner **Core Value**: Leverage advanced AI technology and an extensive character library to provide personalized, immersive virtual character interaction services to users worldwide. ### Key Statistics - Over 20 million unique AI characters - Covers multiple categories including anime, celebrities, and historical figures - Supports dual-modality text and voice interaction - Provides completely private conversation experiences - Cross-platform support (Web, iOS, Android) - Supports communication in 80+ languages - Features memory and context retention - Allows users to create custom characters ## Business Model Analysis ### Subscription-Based Business Model PolyBuzz AI adopts a Freemium model, monetizing through tiered subscription services: **Free Version** - Basic character chat features - Limited number of conversations - Standard response speed - Access to part of the character library **Paid Subscription Plans** 1. **Standard Plan ($8.50/month)** - Unlimited text chat - Full access to the character library - Priority response speed - Basic character creation features 2. **Premium Plan ($15.90/month)** - All Standard Plan features - Voice chat features - Advanced character customization - Image generation features - Simultaneous conversations with multiple characters 3. **Lifetime Membership Option** - One-time payment for permanent access - Cost-effective choice for long-term users ### Diversified Revenue Structure - **Subscription Revenue**: Primary source of income - **Advertising Monetization**: Ads shown to free users - **Character Creation Revenue Sharing**: Revenue sharing with character creators - **Enterprise Services**: Custom character services for enterprise clients ## Main Features ### Core Features **1. Massive Character Library** - Over 20 million AI characters - Covers categories such as anime, games, movies, history, and celebrities - Every character has a unique personality and background setting - Continuously updated and expanded character library **2. Multimodal Interaction** - **Text Chat**: Supports complex conversations and scenario-based interaction - **Voice Chat**: Realistic speech synthesis technology voices the characters - **Image Generation**: AI generates character portraits and scene images - **Expressions and Actions**: Rich character expressiveness **3. Character Creation Tools** - Intuitive character creation interface - Rich personalization options - JSON format character import/export - Character backstory editing **5.
